messages:
Ivy: mist so thick on the street this morning, thought Id teleported to an indie film. :fog:  
Marco: same. lost my bus stop twice. Muni 6 was creeping like a ghost train.  
Tess: public service announcement: a parade of pigeons decided the 3rd St platform was their runway. bus doors wouldnt close for like 30s. driver waved them off like a diplomat.  
Devon: pigeons today, seagulls yesterday? wildlife on tour.  
TransitBot: MUNI ALERT: slow service on 6, 9 due to visibility + animal obstruction reports. expect 10-20 minute delays. https://muni.org/status  
Ivy: poll: you44b commute into office, or embrace WFH fog day?  
Marco: WFH. my bike lights are invisible in this. also wet socks = no.  
Tess: coming in but leaving earlier. Im all about the office heater and donut stash.  
Devon: going in. I need fresh coffee and also I brought extra umbrellas (probably only slightly useful).  
Facilities: Heads up : space heaters turned on in common areas at 08:30 due to building temp dip. Coffee on 2nd floor stocked at 09:00.  
Ivy: donut alert? who brought donuts.  
Tess: that was me 36a. Maple glaze on 2nd floor, help yourselves. :yum:  
Marco: hero of the fog. you44f saved my commute morale.  
TransitBot: CALTRAIN: On schedule. BART: minor delays northbound at Embarcadero (~5-15m).  
Devon: small tip: if you6b2 are biking, avoid painted lanes on Market, they9a4 are slick.  
Ivy: thanks all. summary: some delays, a pigeon coup, donuts exist, heaters on. staying cozy or brave, two valid choices.  
Tess: posted a 6s clip of pigeons for posterity. caption: 99a "the commute rises"  
Marco: if anyone needs a lift from 16th & Mission around 9:10, I can swing by. limited seats.  
Devon: grabbing one if still open! thanks.  
Ivy: stay visible out there, bring extra socks. :sweat_smile:
